targetTexts.1: “At this my heart also pounds and leaps from its place.
targetTexts.2: Listen closely to the thunder of His voice and the rumbling that comes from His mouth.
targetTexts.3: He unleashes His lightning beneath the whole sky and sends it to the ends of the earth.
targetTexts.4: Then there comes a roaring sound; He thunders with His majestic voice. He does not restrain the lightning when His voice resounds.
targetTexts.5: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we cannot comprehend.
targetTexts.6: For He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the gentle rain, ‘Pour out a mighty downpour.’
targetTexts.7: He seals up the hand of every man, so that all men may know His work.
targetTexts.8: The wild animals enter their lairs; they settle down in their dens.
targetTexts.9: The tempest comes from its chamber, and the cold from the driving north winds.
targetTexts.10: By the breath of God the ice is formed and the watery expanses are frozen.
targetTexts.11: He loads the clouds with moisture; He scatters His lightning through them.
targetTexts.12: They swirl about, whirling at His direction, accomplishing all that He commands over the face of all the earth.
targetTexts.13: Whether for punishment or for His land, He accomplishes this in His loving devotion.
targetTexts.14: Listen to this, O Job; stand still and consider the wonders of God.
targetTexts.15: Do you know how God dispatches the clouds or makes the lightning flash?
targetTexts.16: Do you understand how the clouds float, those wonders of Him who is perfect in knowledge?
targetTexts.17: You whose clothes get hot when the land lies hushed under the south wind,
targetTexts.18: can you, like Him, spread out the skies, as strong as a mirror of bronze?
targetTexts.19: Teach us what we should say to Him; we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness.
targetTexts.20: Should He be told that I want to speak? Would a man ask to be swallowed up?
targetTexts.21: Now no one can gaze at the sun when it is bright in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.
targetTexts.22: Out of the north He comes in golden splendor; awesome majesty surrounds Him.
targetTexts.23: The Almighty is beyond our reach; He is exalted in power! In His justice and great righteousness He does not oppress.
targetTexts.24: Therefore, men fear Him, for He is not partial to the wise in heart.”
